title: Cross-Project Review
method: Direct GitHub readback of the amended Stage 17 contract, Stage 16 README contract, claims ledger and root README.
Source-by-source comparison against Production Skills family contracts and implemented sibling public/product contracts.
Machine-readable decision/source register consistency checked before publication.
Remote commit/ref/tree/diff verification is performed after the single Stage 17 commit and is not recursively embedded.

checks.requirement: Software/Game availability checked without treating bootstrap-only surfaces as production evidence
reusable patterns separated from domain-specific imports
Stage 16 README contract still matches current family public pattern
cross-domain abstraction candidates recorded without promotion

publication_gate.reason: A commit cannot recursively contain its own final SHA/ref verification.
required_after_commit: branch ref points to Stage 17 commit
